cases.name: Olórin's Searing Light
cases.text:
Each opponent exiles a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls.
If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, Olórin's Searing Light deals damage to each opponent equal to the power of the creature they exiled.
